feature_name: Golden ratio design system + TodayScreen + local-only BrainDumpScreen
scope_summary: divergify-hub commit 224bb690. Wired new TodayScreen (φ-based capacity meter, derived from the daily overwhelm check-in) above the existing TaskWorkspace at '/'. Replaced the AI-sort/planner-import BrainDump at '/brain-dump' with a new local-storage-only BrainDumpScreen (single large text area on a 61.8/38.2 golden-ratio split, optional tag, optional reversible line sort, warm non-judgmental copy). Removed old routes/Today.tsx and routes/BrainDump.tsx. NOTE: this is a deliberate feature reduction at /brain-dump — AI sort, voice capture, and planner import are gone; the prior in-progress credit-cost work was preserved as a recoverable patch, not deleted.

legal_and_regulatory.rationale: No new legal exposure. BrainDumpScreen stores only what the user types, on-device via localStorage. No accounts, no network, no new claims.
evidence: Storage key divergify.brainDump.v1 is local only

privacy_local_first_promise.rationale: Strengthens the local-first promise: the new BrainDump removed the optional cloud AI sort path entirely. Thought content never leaves the device.

medical_scope_and_claims.rationale: ADHD/neurodivergence context only. Copy is supportive ('get it out of your head'), makes no diagnostic or treatment claims. New Proportion Protocol in the brand spec explicitly states the φ grid is a layout discipline, not a medical claim.

behavioral_science_alignment.rationale: Zero-friction capture with no forced organization matches ADHD-supportive design. Sorting is opt-in and reversible; the default leaves the dump untouched.

neurodivergence_research_alignment.rationale: Externalizing working memory without imposing structure is a recognized ND-supportive pattern. TodayScreen capacity meter reflects the existing overwhelm/support model rather than inventing a new metric.
evidence: capacityPercent = 100 - overwhelm, reuses existing session state

user_benefit_and_harm_check.rationale: Net benefit for zero-friction capture and a calmer Today view. Harm flagged honestly: users who relied on the old /brain-dump AI sort and planner-import lose that flow. Passes because this is an intentional, mitigated scope decision (not a regression) — the prior work is preserved as a recoverable patch and the tradeoff is recorded in ship_decision.conditions.

brand_voice_and_claims.rationale: Copy matches NEUROSCHEMA voice (blunt, warm, no toxic positivity, no shame). Layout conforms to the new v2.1 Proportion Protocol (φ grid).
evidence: BrainDumpScreen copy: 'No order, no spelling, no judgement'

accessibility_and_inclusion.rationale: Text area and progressbar carry aria labels/roles. No flashing. φ rhythm lowers visual parsing load. Shades-mode sensory protocol still takes precedence over proportional polish.

security_and_reliability.rationale: Smaller attack surface — removed the AI/network path from /brain-dump. localStorage access is wrapped in try/catch so storage failure does not crash the screen. Typecheck passes.

monetization_and_dark_pattern_check.rationale: No monetization. No coercive CTAs, countdowns, or pressure. Save is a single neutral action.
evidence: No paywall or upsell in changed files

ship_decision.conditions: Ships as a low-risk, privacy-positive change. One accepted tradeoff: /brain-dump loses AI sort + planner import by design; revisit if the credit-cost feature is resumed from the preserved patch.
